== Summary ==
Title banner for [[Virtual Block 5]] ("The Old Republic"), from the cover page of the Virtual Block 5: The Old Republic PDF. Its cover reads "Official text as of December 7, 2009". The file was created on 1 April 2010.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf VirtualBlock5.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 158 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover image, and cropped to the banner (1028&times;633 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020175310/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-a/a8/Set-VB5-logo.jpg Internet Archive item].
